description: A property tax assessment notice, deed abstract, or county assessor property record showing ownership of real property other than the primary residence. Used to verify real-estate asset value.

owner_name.instruction: The full name of the property owner.

property_address.instruction: The full address of the real property, including city, state, and ZIP code if present.

parcel_number.instruction: The county parcel or assessor identification number for the property.

county_office_name.instruction: The name of the county assessor, recorder, or tax office that issued the document.

document_type.instruction: Type of real-estate document, such as deed, property-tax assessment, or appraisal.

assessed_value.instruction: The total assessed value of the property.

land_value.instruction: The assessed value attributed to the land, if broken out separately.

improvement_value.instruction: The assessed value attributed to improvements or structures, if broken out separately.

loan_balance.instruction: The remaining mortgage or lien balance on the property, if shown.

tax_year.instruction: The tax year the assessment applies to.

document_date.instruction: The date the document was issued or recorded. YYYY-MM-DD format.
